source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: So far we have established that both verbs and adjectives are associated with their own negation: verb-specific suffix -MA and adjective-specific suox. The latter triggers the appearance of the default person marker –A on the adjective which we argued to refer to the adjectival argument. This analysis predicts that nouns which which take no arguments are incompatible with suox as is indeed the case. Instead, they require the copular verb buol ‘be’ which, being a verb, can be negated with the help of the verbal suffix –MA as in (26b).
